verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says an engineer can ask a colleague to cover with a single click on a "Request cover" button and can "Create overrides with a single click." Together these cover the core of the story: self-service overrides and coverage requests without an admin rebuilding the schedule. Missing for 10: an explicit shift-swap feature, docs on whether non-admin responders hold these permissions, in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
